name: Curtis Yarvin
moments: He traces Claremont back to Harry Jaffa and donors Peter Thiel and Paul Singer, lists NatCon and Claremont signers, and calls them part of one Straussian project. He says they debate only how best to advance Israel and ties Bronze Age Pervert, Darren Beattie and Curtis Yarvin to it.

He says Jonathan Keeperman (Lomez), Bronze Age Pervert, Curtis Yarvin and Steve Sailer are Jewish figures steering young white men toward Israel. He reads Keeperman's NatCon speech as a call to drop Holocaust talk and rebrand Israel as strong and vitalist.

He frames the next phase of the right as a fight between an Israel-controlled right led by Thiel and Yarvin and a radical, identitarian, Jew-suspicious America First tradition, and says he is finished with Trump.
He describes Palantir's founders Alex Karp, Joe Lonsdale and Peter Thiel as Jewish supremacists, Zionists and leftists, and ties Thiel to Barry Weiss, Curtis Yarvin and others.

He says he will not vote for Vance in 2028 and argues Vance is a Trojan horse, a handshake between globalist elites and white voters, groomed by Thiel, Curtis Yarvin and David Frum to sell the status quo to the base.

He says right-wing figures such as Curtis Yarvin and JD Vance associate with transgender people, so he doubts their Christian motives. He calls child transition surgery satanic but says the next step is to confront divorce and porn.
Curtis Yarvin, who everybody loves, had a transgender wedding hosted in his home.
He announces a Twitter space with Remilia CEO Charlotte Fang after a dispute with Vitalik, and says he wants to press people from the Curtis Yarvin and little-tech sphere.
